page: Microsoft Azure D248ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 server family. It features 248 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 992.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type includes 15,118 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity local disk space directly attached to the instance. It is also premium storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. No GPUs are included in this configuration, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The D248ds_v7 offers high resource density, combining massive CPU core counts with substantial local NVMe storage. This profile is designed for large-scale workloads that require significant parallel processing and fast local data access, such as enterprise databases, large-scale data warehousing, and heavy general-purpose application servers.
